unsupported.title: This browser cannot open this page
unsupported.text: This browser lacks features this page needs, so the page cannot be drawn. Use a current version of your browser, or another browser.
requirements: What this service needs from a browser
noscript.console.title: Scripts are blocked
noscript.console: This console is a script that runs in your browser and draws every page from /admin-api; with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show.
noscript.portal: This portal is a script that runs in your browser and draws every page from /account-api; with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show.
noscript.signin.title: Sign in
noscript.signin: This sign-in page is a script that runs in your browser, and with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show. Allow scripts for this page to sign in.
noscript.gnap.title: GNAP authorization
noscript.gnap: This page is a script that runs in your browser, and with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show. Allow scripts for this page to answer the application that sent you here.
noscript.consent.title: Allow access?
noscript.consent: This consent page is a script that runs in your browser, and with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show. Allow scripts for this page to answer it.
noscript.signout.title: Sign out
noscript.signout: This sign-out page is a script that runs in your browser, and with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show. Allow scripts for this page to see what you are still signed into and to sign out.
noscript.federation.title: Federation
noscript.federation: This page is a script that runs in your browser, and with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show. Allow scripts for this page.
noscript.home: This front page is a script that runs in your browser and draws itself from {api}; with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show.
noscript.description: This page is a script that runs in your browser, and with scripts blocked there is nothing it can show. Allow scripts for this page, or add ?format=json for the same description as data.
noStorage.title: This browser cannot sign you in here
noStorage.text: This browser does not let this page use session storage, which signing in needs. Private browsing and some privacy settings block it: allow site data for this site, then reload the page.
noPasskeys: This browser cannot use passkeys: WebAuthn is unavailable. Use a current browser, or another device.
copyFailed.hint: This browser could not copy the text. Select it and copy it yourself.
stateRestored: You are signed in again. The choices on this page were put back, and nothing was sent: make the change again to send it.
stateOtherPerson: A different person signed in, so the choices on this page were not put back.
